in_marathi.name: Jaishree
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jaishree हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Jaishree is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Jai’ meaning victory and ‘Shree’ meaning God. This name signifies the victory of God in one's life. It is a name often given to a girl born in Hindu families, signifying the victory of the divine over the mundane.
